stem: A recurring contamination event appears in one propagation bay after each transplant cycle. Cleaning logs are complete, but carts from an adjacent production room enter that bay during setup. What is the strongest next investigation step?
choices: Assume the cleaning product has failed and double its concentration
Review the cart movement and sanitation pathway as a plausible repeated transfer route while preserving other hypotheses
Stop collecting sanitation records because they did not prevent the event
Replace all propagation lighting before checking movement patterns
rationale: A repeated event linked to cross-zone equipment movement warrants investigation of that transfer pathway. Complete records help narrow hypotheses but do not prove the pathway is controlled.
